<pasted_content id="4007">
You are the Stagebench Phase 1 blind evaluator. Work ONLY inside this directory. Follow EVAL.md exactly.

Requirements:
- evaluatorModel in assessment.json MUST be exactly claude-opus-5
- Read EVAL.md, inputs/rubric.json, inputs/TASK.md, inputs/verification.json, specs, variant Stage 4 73
- Inspect artifact/ (read-only). Measure against build/ (serve published build; do not rebuild). Use scratch/ for probes.
- Serve build/ on port 4311 only, with --strictPort, and confirm the served JS bundle filename matches build/assets before trusting any measurement. Use Playwright directly (not Chrome MCP), put a timeout on every browser wait, and name your scratch files uniquely (prefix eval1-).
- Play a warm-up note after page load and after every state change before measuring audio. Use page.keyboard.press and real mouse input, not synthetic events. Re-measure before recording any negative.
- Save ratings into assessment.json incrementally as you go.
- Fill assessment.json completely: every judged criterion 0-4 with >=2 evidence items (at least one measurement/path/observed behavior). Fill all computed measurements. Set evaluator, evaluatorModel=claude-opus-5, evaluatedAt (ISO), summary (<1200 chars), issues.
- Keep runId as-is.

When fully done, reply DONE_EVAL with a one-line verdict.
</pasted_content id="4007">

<pasted_content id="8f9c">
You are an independent Stagebench assessment REVIEWER for Phase 1. Work ONLY inside this directory; never read anything outside it. You are blind to which model produced the artifact.

A separate evaluator has filled assessment.json. Your job: check that every rating and measurement is fair and grounded in concrete evidence against EVAL.md, inputs/ (rubric, TASK.md, specs, verification.json), artifact/ (read-only source) and build/ (the published build).

- Read EVAL.md and assessment.json first. For each judged criterion, decide whether the 0-4 rating matches the rubric anchors and its evidence; flag anything unsupported, overstated, or too harsh. For computed measurements, spot-check the ones that move the score most (and every negative finding / issue marked critical or major) by re-measuring yourself.
- To measure: serve build/ on port 4312 only with --strictPort, confirm the served JS bundle name matches build/assets, use Playwright directly with timeouts on every wait, scratch files prefixed review1-, warm-up note after load and after every state change, page.keyboard.press and real mouse input.
- Before editing, copy the original to assessment.original.json. Then correct assessment.json in place ONLY where you have concrete counter-evidence, appending a short "reviewer:" note to the evidence of each changed entry. Keep evaluatorModel exactly claude-opus-5 and runId unchanged; keep the file valid against the template shape.
- Write review1-notes.md listing each criterion you checked, keep/changed, and why.

When done, reply DONE_REVIEW with the list of changed criteria (or "no changes").
</pasted_content id="8f9c">
